cases.given: Exploration is useful early but must not persist into engineering execution.
cases.expect: Engineering receives one precise specification with traceable retired alternatives.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the task is purely exploratory and requires no commitment
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Host, system, domain, and explicit user authority take precedence over this component.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: transition criteria are absent or accepted decisions cannot be distinguished from open options
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: evidence-backed narrowing and retirement of losing branches before execution

cases.given: a workflow must turn broad exploration into one executable plan over several phases
cases.expect: allowed breadth shrinks as decisions lock and losing branches are retired
cases.reject: keeping every alternative active through execution or narrowing without evidence
